'''Yanic Konan Niederhauser''' (born 14 March 2003) is a Swiss [[college basketball]] player for the [[Penn State Nittany Lions men's basketball|Penn State Nittany Lions]] of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. He previously played for the [[Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball|Northern Illinois Huskies]].

==Early life and high school==
During the 2021–22 season, Konan Niederhauser played for [[Ehingen Urspring]] a pro German team on both its youth team and its German Pro A League squad. After the season, he committed to play [[college basketball]] in the United States for the [[Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball|Northern Illinois Huskies]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Valladares |first1=Brennan |title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser is a Jump Shot Away from Being the Perfect Center Piece for Penn State |url=https://nittanysportsnow.com/2024/11/yanic-konan-niederhauser-penn-state/ |website=Nittany Sports Now |access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref>

==College career==
===Northern Illinois===
As a [[freshman]] in 2022–23, Konan Niederhauser played in 20 games with two starts, averaging 2.2 points and 1.5 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite web |title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser 2022-23 Game Log |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/yanic-konan-niederhauser-1/gamelog/2023 |website=Sports Reference |access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref> During the 2023–24 season, he made 26 starts, averaging 7.3 points and 4.4 rebounds per game.<ref name="Max Ralph">{{cite web |last1=Ralph |first1=Max |title=Penn State 7-footer Yanic Konan Niederhauser one to watch as Lions wrap up summer: basketball notes |url=https://www.pennlive.com/penn-state-mens-basketball/2024/08/penn-state-7-footer-yanic-konan-niederhauser-one-to-watch-as-lions-wrap-up-summer-basketball-notes.html |website=PennLive.com |access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref> After the 2023–24 season, Konan Niederhauser entered his name into the [[NCAA transfer portal]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wogenrich |first1=Mark |title=Penn State Basketball Lands Shot-Blocking Forward From Transfer Portal |url=https://www.si.com/college/pennstate/news/penn-state-basketball-nittany-lions-transfer-yanic-konan-niederhauser-ncaa-transfer-portal |work=Penn State Nittany Lions on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=15 May 2025}}</ref>

==National team career==
Konan Niederhauser first represented Switzerland at youth level, during the [[2021 FIBA U18 European Challengers]] competition. He averaged 10.3 points, 7.7 rebounds and 2.7 blocks per game by the end of the tournament.<ref>{{cite news|title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser 2021 FIBA U18 European Challengers profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/264-fiba-u18-european-challengers/208419/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=8 August 2021}}</ref> In 2022, with the U20 national team at the [[2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]], he averaged 6.6 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.7 blocks during the event.<ref>{{cite news|title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser 2022 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/280-fiba-u20-eurobasket-division-b/208472/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=24 July 2022}}</ref> In July 2023, Konan Niederhauser returned to the U20 national team for the [[2023 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B]]. He finished with averages of 7.7 points, 4.4 rebounds and 2.0 blocks per game.<ref>{{cite news|title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser 2023 FIBA U20 European Championship Division B profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/280-fiba-u20-eurobasket-division-b/208579/players/248664-yanic-niederhauser|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=16 July 2023}}</ref>

Following Konan Niederhauser's stint at the youth level in July 2023, he was named to the senior [[Switzerland men's national basketball team|Switzerland national team]] later that month, for the third round of [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification|EuroBasket 2025 Pre-Qualifiers]]. In his two games against [[Kosovo men's national basketball team|Kosovo]] and [[Denmark men's national basketball team|Denmark]], he averaged 11.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 2.0 blocks per game.<ref>{{cite news|title=Yanic Konan Niederhauser EuroBasket 2025 Pre-Qualifiers profile|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/history/204-fiba-eurobasket-pre-qualifiers/208437/players/248664-yanic-konan-niederhauser|work=fiba.basketball|access-date=2 August 2023}}</ref>
